access.notes: Open-source all-electron LAPW code for DFT-LDA calculations. Used for structural relaxation, band structures, optical matrix elements and absorption spectra, and core-level alignment.

Crystal structures in space group R-3m (No. 166) for CuAlO2, CuGaO2, CuInO2. Available from the Inorganic Crystal Structure Database (ICSD) or constructible from literature lattice parameters. The agent must start from experimental parameters as described in the instruction.
